description_en: Checks the CNAME resolution of accelerated domain names to determine whether CNAME configuration is complete
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainCname对加速域名CNAME进行解析检测，查看解析结果判断是否完成CNAME配置
name: DescribeDcdnDomainCname

parameters.description_en: The accelerated domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). You can specify up to 30 domain names in a single query.
parameters.description_zh: 加速域名，多个以逗号（,）分隔，单次查询最多支持30个域名。
parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). You can specify up to 30 domain names in a single query
parameters.help_zh: 加速域名，多个以逗号（,）分隔，单次查询最多支持30个域名
